messages:
sam: heads-up — after the vpc egress default-deny + new kms key policy rollout, warm-pool GPUs in us-west-2 are failing keystore decrypts during bootstrap. join rate dropped ~42%.

neha: logs: 
```
ERROR keystore.decrypt node=wp-17 status=403 error=AccessDenied detail=MissingCondition aws:SourceVpc=vpc-0aa11bb
WARN warmup.join node=wp-17 reason=\"keystore handshake timeout\"
```

kai: looks like a combination: key policy expects aws:SourceVpc but privatelink presents a different source, and TLS inspection rollout was also active so some requests are failing cert validation. two unrelated controls colliding.

rachel: immediate mitigations: (A) issue temporary scoped kms grants to warmpool role ARNs (fast, low-cost), (B) short TTL firewall allowlist to route warmpool via control-plane proxy (adds nat/egress cost), (C) temporary inspection bypass for vpce-0keystore (reduces visibility). recommend (A) + (C) if needed.

maria: cost note: firewall/proxy path ~ $900-1.6k/day; SOC pre-approve for 24h if ticketed. grants must be recorded and retired.

sam: executing (A) now — creating grants scoped to role/warmpool-role with RetireAfter=2h. posting grantARN to ticket once done.

ops-bot: INC-9102 created for keystore bootstrap failures. linked mitigations: KMS-GRANT-201 + NET-CR-1201 (inspection-bypass). escalate to security@redwood if grants remain >2h.

kai: after grants applied joins climbed back to ~97% within 8m. TLS inspection bypass applied in staging as canary; will apply prod if needed.

rachel: follow-ups: add policy linter to flag SourceVpc vs SourceVpce mismatches, add warm-pool bootstrap canary to rollout gating, add automated retire job for temporary grants, and document inspection bypass runbook.

sam: noted. I'll draft the postmortem and create followup tickets. closing after grants retired and bypass removed. :thumbsup:
